scope: Participant learning eligibility for the intended three-Character private VTI delayed-daily shadow pilot; not execution or performance approval.
decision_rule: Every intended participant must pass its named foundation and evidence checks. No replacement by a fixture or omission of an unready participant.
shared_criteria: Validated nonfixture source, immutable Character, frozen prior and exact pinned curriculum in original order.
Reviewed coverage agrees with ordered checkpoints, citations, dispositions, objections, memory and saved theories; retain partial material and hindsight contamination.
A version pins the reviewed constitution and exact knowledge ancestry; foundation readiness supplies no prospective performance evidence.
Apply only the scoped role below. Abstain when supporting data, a preregistered decision rule or independent risk policy is absent. Daily observation does not require daily trading.

participants.role: Initial council lead and independent broad-fund baseline reasoning, subject to independent policy; Bogle-grounded costs, diversification, long horizons and explicit abstention.
participants.entry_rationale: The completed Bogle foundation covers this limited role. Books 2–4 and an active timing edge are not required for this participant-learning gate.
participants.excluded_claims: The S&P 500 mutual-fund cost theory is not a VTI daily signal or evaluated result. Current fees, taxes, prices and fund properties need qualified current evidence.

participants.role: Independent price-versus-value and margin-of-safety critique; abstain when a broad ETF's daily bars cannot support a valuation claim.
participants.entry_rationale: Complete the pinned Graham foundation, including its later margin-of-safety argument and qualifications. The introduction alone explicitly lacks those methods. Books 2–4 are not this gate.
participants.excluded_claims: Daily VTI bars alone do not establish business value or margin of safety. No forced active opinion.

participants.role: Independent trend-system research in shadow mode; require a preregistered entry, sizing, exit and invalidation rule before any active signal, otherwise abstain.
participants.entry_rationale: Complete the pinned Faith foundation to cover the system beyond its opening market-participant chapter. Books 2–4 and earned council leadership are not this gate.
participants.excluded_claims: Historical futures and execution anecdotes do not validate transfer to an unleveraged VTI daily system or establish current trading costs.

step_11_prerequisites: All three participants pass this learning gate; keep the intended roster unchanged.
Implement and review real-source v2 forward integration, including immutable Character/knowledge ancestry and eligibility enforcement; current shared integration accepts fixtures only.
Qualify the dividend/split evidence needed for total-return comparisons.
Preregister future dates, horizons, decision and abstention rules, runtime/model/prompt/usage pins and finite risk policy before outcomes; preserve independent memories and equal snapshots.
authority: Owner explicitly requested completion of both Value and Trend foundations followed by Step 11. Both complete pinned books were reviewed in this Codex task; this gate reconciles their new immutable checkpoints. No performance or broker-operation approval is implied.
